title: Determine costs to capitalize for land, land improvements, equipment, buildings, and construction in process

items.concept: Classify and capitalize land, land improvements, equipment, and CIP; expense noncapital costs; initial recognition JE; period-end depreciation adjusting JEs (emphasis); subsequent CV schedule; CIP settlement to Building; equipment disposal
Number-variant twin — classify/capitalize land, land improvements, equipment, and CIP; period-end dep AJs (emphasis); subsequent CV schedule; CIP → Building; equipment disposal
Self-constructed asset cost accumulation in CIP; completion JE with fair-value ceiling (cost > FV → loss); period-end depreciation adjusting JE (emphasis); subsequent CV schedule; disposal settlement
Classification — which costs are capitalized as Land (nondepreciable) versus land improvements or period expense
Classification / method — when costs move from CIP to Building and when depreciation begins
